WITH customer_accounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.state_county_province
  FROM Customers c
  INNER JOIN Accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
),
state_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    state_county_province,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) as customer_count
  FROM customer_accounts
  GROUP BY state_county_province
),
total_customers AS (
  SELECT SUM(customer_count) as total FROM state_counts
),
state_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.state_county_province,
    sc.customer_count,
    CAST(sc.customer_count AS DECIMAL(19,4)) / CAST(tc.total AS DECIMAL(19,4)) as share
  FROM state_counts sc
  CROSS JOIN total_customers tc
),
avg_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as average_share FROM state_shares
),
above_average_states AS (
  SELECT 
    ss.customer_count,
    ss.share,
    (ss.share - asc.average_share) as excess
  FROM state_shares ss
  CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc asc
  WHERE ss.share > asc.average_share
)
SELECT
  SUM(customer_count) as combined_count,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(excess) as average_excess
FROM above_average_states;
